blurb: Experience the water in ultimate comfort and style! This roomy Bayliner Element is perfect for groups, offering ample space for five passengers and a generous bimini top to keep everyone cool and shaded on sunny days. With its relaxed pace and comfortable ride, it's the ideal way to enjoy a leisurely outing on the bay at cruising speed of 10 km/h.
